notes.title: Fantasy Creature Jigsaw 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[p]Thanks for your support! Your feedback has been a huge help in shaping this update. We've made some substantial improvements to the game and would love to hear what you think, so please feel free to leave a review or comment in the discussions.

[/p][list][*][p] 20 new puzzles across 4 categories added
[/p][/*][*][p] Existing puzzles upscaled and improved
[/p][/*][*][p] Hard mode added for puzzling without the puzzle shadow
[/p][/*][*][p] Added Gold, Silver & Bronzes badges for beating par times in the puzzles
[/p][/*][*][p] Performance improvement when generating puzzle pieces
[/p][/*][*][p] General UI upgrades
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Thanks all![/p]
